verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a single API call to create a virtual card (POST /cards) and a sandbox environment that mirrors production for testing cards/transactions/webhooks, supporting the core create-card-in-sandbox flow. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming that PAN, CVV, and expiry are returned synchronously in the creation response, nor evidence describing a self-serve path from sandbox to live production without a sales/onboarding process. Missing for 10: explicit PAN/CVV/expiry-in-response confirmation, evidence of self-serve production activation without sales cycle.
